reviews.text:
Five stars isn't enough! Aunt Carla was the only one who agreed to trim my dog's nails, who is very scared, very nervous, and a biter. Even though the dog was extremely nervous, she managed the situation perfectly and trimmed her nails.
Professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly patient.
Thank you so much!

A truly positive experience!
Aunt Carla groomed and clipped our cat's nails. I was there, and it was a pleasure to see her work and handle Giulio (the big cat) with love, affection, and immense experience!
We'll definitely be back!!
Fantastic!

Aunt Carla is very good at her job, she knows how to deal with all dog temperaments, from the most fearful to the most euphoric, I have known her for years and my dogs and I have always gotten along well!

I came to Aunt Carla, who isn't in my area, because I have a Lagotto Romagnolo, and she's one of the very few who knows how to groom him without turning him into a poodle. She's excellent with scissors, precise, and knowledgeable. I really like the way she handles the dog: determined in her movements, but with the ability to not agitate the dog. She's also friendly, which doesn't hurt the human who has to wait! Highly recommended!

Excellent, cheerful, expert, and professional.
Number One
Thank you, Carla!!! First experience for my Enzo... what can I say, wonderful.... Such a great love for animals and so much advice for us owners... thank you 🤩 …

Aunt Carla is number one. I took my five-month-old poodle to the groomer for the first time (alas, don't do that!) She was incredible; she taught Pepe how to stay calm throughout the entire wash, especially during the trickiest part... untangling his hair. I'd sum up my experience with: passion, preparation, and impeccability. I highly recommend her.
I bring my two Persians Nocciola and my black Labrador Vasco to Aunt Carla. What can I say? She's brilliant and they love her! 🩷 I highly recommend her! …
An excellent professional, she creates a family-like yet extremely professional atmosphere. I highly recommend her!

Excellent groomer who does her job professionally and treats our furry friends with infinite sweetness and love. My Kira happily goes to her for a bath, as the attached photos show. Highly recommended. Thank you.
Romoletto has never been so happy to take a bath 😁 …

Simply adorable.. she was the groomer of my previous dog Camillo and now of my Sophie.. highly recommended and very sweet with everyone and I mean all furry friends and owners.. REALLY top 🤩 if there were 10.. 100... 1000 stars I would have given them all and more.. Thank God there are such special people on this earth 🌎...
💯💫❤️💘🥰😍🫶😍
She managed to groom Leone, our untamable and spoiled Lagotto. Excellent, competent, courageous, strict, and loving. A true educator, even for his owners.

Came here for an emergency. Weimaraner rolled on the lawn. Aunt Carla immediately found us a space! Very good and professional. Polite. A true animal lover. My dog ​​came out smelling fresh and disinfected. Thanks Carla! See you soon!
She understands animals well and knows how to handle them, but I think it's time to fix that post.

It couldn't be better!
Forever faithful to Aunt Carla
